Manage a National Team?

You can manage a nation alongside your club career. Select squads, guide World Qualifiers and compete in the World Championship and World Games.

Career settings

These settings are stored with this career and applied to the simulation.
Salary CapEnforce cap space and salary matching for signings and trades.
InjuriesPlayers can miss games based on fatigue, age and workload.
League ExpansionAllow the league to expand from 30 to 32 clubs during your career.
Commissioner ModeTake greater control of the league during your career, including expansion, team changes and selected league rules.
